text:
dana: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — capturing the Qs we promised to answer and the next steps. TL;DR: Dedicated GA target moved to May 14, rollout will be tier-first then regional, private/on-prem preview in June. Owners and short actions below.

leah: When you say 'tier-first' — does that mean enterprise customers get GA before self-serve?

dana: Yes — enterprise Dedicated customers first (reason: contractual onboarding + perf validation), then self-serve Dedicated. Regionally we'll do us -> eu -> apac.

samir: Any breaking changes we should warn SDK users about?

dana: No breaking REST/SDK API changes. We will expose a couple runtime defaults (batching window, kv-prefetch) which may change perf. @aj will publish a clear changelog + migration notes.

aj: I'll draft the changelog tomorrow and include a small code snippet for the migration path. Will post link when ready.

maria: Sales asked about token-cost guarantees for Dedicated customers — are we offering anything concrete at GA?

dana: Not a hard cost SLA at GA. We'll publish expected per-token latency targets and pricing tiers. Reserved (contracted) customers can get tighter cost/latency commitments post-GA.

leah: Action quick list (per discussion):
- leah -> add GA checklist item for compliance docs
- samir -> run SDK compatibility tests against canary and report
- aj -> changelog + migration snippet
- maria -> pricing blurb for sales collateral

samir: :eyes: I'll run the test matrix against the canary by Thu and post results in #eng-runtime.

aj: Draft note posted (internal): https://redwood-internal/notes/dedicated-ga-draft — will update with changelog and code snippets and ping here.

dana: Quick additional Q from the live Q&A: what's the timeline for private/on-prem installs?

dana: Preview build for private deploys (air-gapped installer + minimal control-plane) targeted for June with a security review window. We'll need folks from security and infra for validation.

maria: I'll coordinate with security and schedule a review next week. Adding KMS/HSM integration checklist to that ticket.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: infra PR merged by @infra-team — https://git.internal/pr/1234 (infra capacity bump for Dedicated).

leah: Can someone produce a single owners/features mapping doc we can share with customers and sales?

dana: Yes — I'll create a GA one-pager (features, owners, comms status) and share a view-only link. Expect v0 Monday.

leah: Great. Closing ask: owners update that one-pager and then ping #product once items are in. :white_check_mark: 

dana: Thanks all. If you raised a live question and didn't see it above, ping me directly and I'll add it.

maria: Added calendar invite for security sync.

aj: Will post changelog link here when ready.

samir: Test results will be in #eng-runtime by Thu.
